title: Lashup high-powered over-the-horizon radar

tellings.quote: It was it was they were testing it for the Navy. It was called lashup. Lashup later became adopted by the air force as well.

plain: In New Mexico in the years after 1947, the military tested a powerful radar that could see beyond the horizon, called Lashup, first for the Navy and later taken up by the Air Force as well, according to a researcher named Scott Ramsey. Ramsey describes it without naming a source, in connection with the green fireballs reported over New Mexico in that period, suggesting such radar may have been tracking strange objects in the sky.
